items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: Peter Matz who I did an awful lot of stuff with Peter Matz, he was Barbra Streisand’s conductor when I worked with her an awful lot.

ctx.x: Like you have to know the right priorities in order to salvage yourself spiritually in a situation like that because you can psychologically turn yourself into a banana pie if you don’t watch out, real quick. So like you look at the tempo, then look at the key signature, then look at the roadmap. Where are the endings? Is there a coda? Where is the coda sign? Where does it go to? Where are the repeats? Like know the roadmap, where you’re going to get in, where you’ve got to go back to if at all. Then you start…
Were the writers and arrangers always at the sessions?
